content:
Hi all, I'm putting together lectures on Lean based on @Alex Meiburg's QuantumInfo repository, and will try to include as much as possible of physics more broadly and Physlib.

This is an University of Waterloo course under the Institute for Quantum Computing, and it will take place in the Perimeter Institute. The course is not widely public available, but will have openly available free recordings coming out weekly on pirsa.org.

The aim here is to popularize the topic, so hopefully we'll get more people and students involved in growing Physlib and QuantumInfo libraries!

A link for the schedule: https://events.perimeterinstitute.ca/category/133/
